name: PLS Weather
tagline: US weather on free NOAA data. No ads, no account, no tracking.
overview: PLS Weather is a US weather app built on the National Weather Service's free public data. Current conditions, the full hourly and 7-day forecast, live NOAA radar and severe weather alerts are all free, with no ads, no account and no tracking. It names its sources and times on every screen, and says so when weather is old or a reading is missing.

capabilities.title: First run in two taps
capabilities.text: Pick Dark, Light or Follow device, then Use My Location, Pick a Place or Decide Later. No account, no sign-up.

proofs.caption: Then: your location, a place, or later

capabilities.title: Your location, only when you ask
capabilities.text: Looks up where you are only when you tap, rounded to about 350 feet, never in the background. Android asks first.

proofs.caption: The app explains before Android asks

capabilities.title: Home at a glance
capabilities.text: Where you are, the current reading with its station and time, the forecasters' one-line summary, the next hours and the next 7 days on one screen.

proofs.caption: Home on the open Fold: Chicago, IL, live NOAA data

capabilities.title: Live map on Home
capabilities.text: Pinch, drag and zoom the map; one-tap boxes for Rain & Storms, Snow, Ice, Wind and Alerts; a color legend and a radar line that says how fresh the radar is.

proofs.caption: Map, tick boxes and legend; radar status at the bottom of the map

capabilities.title: Detail cards
capabilities.text: Wind dial with gusts, humidity, dew point in plain words, pressure gauge with its trend, visibility and the sun's day, two across.

proofs.caption: Wind, humidity, dew point, pressure and the 7 days
Visibility, sun, and the jump cards to every part

capabilities.title: Current details
capabilities.text: Every reading from the nearest NWS station: temperature, feels like, wind and gusts, humidity, dew point, pressure trend, visibility, sunrise and sunset. UV says plainly that NWS has no source.

capabilities.title: Hourly, straight across midnight
capabilities.text: The next 48 hours by default, or any single day from the day buttons, with temperature, precipitation and wind graphs and a full table.

proofs.caption: Precip graph: rain chance and amount

capabilities.title: 7-day forecast
capabilities.text: Each day with its day and night icons, rain chance, amount and high/low range; tap a day for Day and Night detail.

proofs.caption: Tap Sunday: the full day, Day and Night

capabilities.title: Graphs
capabilities.text: Temperature, precipitation, wind and humidity over 24 h, 48 h or the full forecast.

capabilities.title: Radar loop with honest times
capabilities.text: NOAA radar played as a loop; every frame shows its time and "frame N of M", LIVE only when the newest frame is under 15 minutes old. Iowa State is the automatic backup.

proofs.caption: Loop running: frame 3 of 7, 13 min ago
Paused on the newest frame: LIVE

capabilities.title: Map layers, one switch each
capabilities.text: NOAA radar, the NWS alert map, fronts with highs and lows, and today's rain, snow, ice and severe-storm areas, each on or off.

capabilities.title: Map style
capabilities.text: Choose the base map: roads and towns, satellite photo with labels, or outlines only, with a strength slider.

capabilities.title: Playback settings
capabilities.text: Loop length (30 min, 1 or 2 hours), speed and radar opacity. The timestamp is always on.

capabilities.title: Temperature map
capabilities.text: A Temp box tints the map with this hour's NWS temperature forecast.

capabilities.title: Severe weather alerts
capabilities.text: Active NWS watches, warnings and advisories for every saved place: a banner on Home, a list, and a detail page split into What, Where, When, Impacts and What to do.

proofs.caption: A live Wind Advisory on Home (Omaha, NE)
Active alerts for every saved place
Alert detail from the NWS bulletin

capabilities.title: Alert settings and a test alert
capabilities.text: Alerts per place, a severity floor, quiet hours that tornado warnings always break through, and a button that sends a test tornado alert.

proofs.caption: Per-place switches, severity floor, quiet hours
Send a test tornado alert: it arrives as a notification

capabilities.title: Forecast discussion
capabilities.text: The local NWS office's own discussion, as a summary of their key messages or the full text, with text size.

capabilities.title: Unlimited saved places, searched on the phone
capabilities.text: Search by city or ZIP from a US place list built into the app (nothing you type is sent), save as many places as you like, drag to reorder.

proofs.caption: Search "Denver": results come from the phone
Search a ZIP: 68102 is Omaha, NE
Drag the handle: Omaha moves above Denver

capabilities.title: Sun and Moon
capabilities.text: Sunrise, sunset, daylight length, twilight, and the moon phase drawn with how much is lit, worked out on the phone.

capabilities.title: Units
capabilities.text: °F, °C or K; mph, km/h, m/s, knots or Beaufort; inches or mm; inHg, hPa or mb; miles or km. Applied at once.

capabilities.title: History and Undo
capabilities.text: Every change is written to History, and Undo walks back the last 50 steps.

proofs.caption: Undo names what it will undo
History: every change, with the time

capabilities.title: Themes and the eye
capabilities.text: Light, Dark, AMOLED, Pulse or follow the device, four text sizes, and the eye at the top that flips light and dark in one tap.

proofs.caption: Tap the eye: Home flips to light

capabilities.title: Keeps itself fresh
capabilities.text: While it is open the weather updates every 3, 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes; shows when each place was last fetched; Refresh Now on demand.

capabilities.title: Honest when offline
capabilities.text: With no connection it keeps showing the saved weather, says so at the top with the time it was saved, and offers Retry.

proofs.caption: No connection: "Offline · Cached Weather" with the saved time

capabilities.title: What it collects: nothing
capabilities.text: No ads, no analytics, no account. The Privacy page names every permission and the weather hosts it talks to.

capabilities.title: Report a Problem
capabilities.text: Write what happened and choose what to attach; it is sent only when you tap Send.

proofs.caption: Report a Problem (nothing was sent for this picture)

capabilities.title: Help on every screen
capabilities.text: The i on every screen says what it shows, its source and its time; a full offline manual, About the Data, and About.

capabilities.title: Drive mode
capabilities.text: One tap starts Drive mode: it keeps watching the weather on your path, with a notification the whole time and a way to stop it.

capabilities.title: Weather ahead on your path
capabilities.text: While you drive: your heading, your last hour, and the warnings and weather where you will be in the next two hours, spoken if you like.

capabilities.title: Crosswind while driving
capabilities.text: Wind across your direction of travel, turning yellow and red near the limit you pick for high-profile vehicles.

capabilities.title: Folded and unfolded
capabilities.text: On the open Fold the map sits left and the forecast right; folded, everything stacks in one column.

proofs.caption: Folded, scrolled: next hours and 7 days

demo.caption: 39 seconds: Home, the detail cards, the hourly forecast and a single day, then the live radar.

note: Captured with demo places only (Chicago IL, Denver CO, Omaha NE).
